newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rain delays French field pea harvest in north.
newsitem.headline: Rain delays French field pea harvest in north.

text.p: Rain and cold temperatures delayed the start of the field pea harvest in northern France while combining went on rapidly in the south, industry group UNIP said on Friday.
It said that as of June 25 the harvest was half complete in the southwest and southeast with initial results suggesting wide variations in yields depending on moisture levels.
But heading north, wet conditions prevented farmers from starting the harvest in the Poitou-Charentes and Pays-de-Loire regions.
In northern France colder temperatures sharply slowed down crop development but were not yet threatening yield potential.
But as more rain is forecast for the coming days, farmers fear that harvesting of crops that have reached maturity will be pushed back.
France produced 2.59 million tonnes of field peas for protein last year. The average yield was 4.83 tonnes a hectare.
